title: Pocket Chainsaw – Portable Hand Saw with Non-Slip Handles
descriptionHtml:
Saw wood anywhere – fits in your pocket

When you're out in the woods, at the campsite or just clearing a branch in the garden, a big saw is both heavy and awkward to haul around. But without a saw you end up standing there breaking branches by hand.

Full sawing power in pocket size

The pocket chainsaw is a chain with sharp teeth and two non-slip handles. You put it around the branch and pull back and forth – the chain does the job in seconds. Folded up, it fits in your pocket or backpack and weighs next to nothing.

Features

  • Sharp chain that saws through branches in seconds
  • Non-slip handles for a secure grip
  • Weighs next to nothing – fits in your pocket
  • Perfect for camping, hiking and survival gear
  • No battery, no fuel – always ready

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
